purpose: Royal edict granting additional privileges to a village, limiting the mallakara tax to 4 tāmrapaṇas, and prohibiting entry of cāṭas and bhaṭas
notes: The opening lines bearing the issuing king's name and the issuing seat (reconstructed by scholars as King Śivadeva I ruling from Mānagṛha) are completely eroded and lost; hence only the dūtaka is preserved in the inscription text.
